body.name: \(\widehat\nu_n^{\mathrm{net}}\)
body.def: The total estimator defined in \(\mathrm{def:finite\text{-}net\text{-}law\text{-}estimator}\) by nearest search over a deterministic \(n^{-1/2}\)-net of admissible summaries, stable singular-value thresholding, and aggregate spectral-projector masses.
